title: Dog Day Afternoon
about: A bank robbery in Brooklyn turns into a hot, chaotic media circus.
cue: Order the pizza when it gets delivered to the bank.
faces: On the avenue, two doors from the barber shop.
Air conditioned. Eat in, cool off.
Our own tomato sauce, whole-milk mozzarella and romano.
Thin crust, crushed tomato, oregano, mozzarella and spicy cured sausage.
Thick and airy, risen in a black steel pan.
Beef and pork meatballs, tomato sauce, melted mozzarella.
Sweet fennel links with green peppers and onions fried soft.
Fried crisp, baked under the sauce.
Around the corner, the picture house.
Prices subject to change. Brooklyn, N.Y.
Three big meatballs in a slow Sunday sauce.
Ricotta and mozzarella, baked bubbling in the sauce.
Ham, salami, provolone, iceberg, tomato, oil, vinegar and oregano. Pressed, cut in wedges.
Ridged chips, slow-browned onions in sour cream, cream cheese and chives.
Fresh juice and zest, frozen and scraped fluffy. Paper cups.
Over two cubes, a fresh squeeze, glass rimmed with chilli salt and zest.
Cola, orange, cream, root beer or ginger ale.
Bank and office lunches by noon. Our boys ride bicycles. We don't take the car.
